name: XDKNet 2.8.0
body:
Android TV 2.8.0. Update the server plugin to XDKNet 2.1.0.18 (Emby
2.0.5.18) as well: settings added since 2.6, such as Hide Controls After,
Peek Home Rows or the hidden detail sections, were not kept by the server
before it, so they did not reach your other devices. Set them again once
after updating and they will.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

More from Moonfin 2.7 to 3.1.

## Live TV

- **Rewind**: on a channel the server lets you rewind, the controls gain
  Seek back, Seek forward and Jump to Live, with a timeline. With the
  controls hidden, Left and Right scrub, and holding them speeds up.
- The remote's **DVR** button opens Recordings, **CC** the subtitles,
  **Audio** the audio tracks and **Record** the record options, in the
  player. DVR also works in the guide, and Guide and DVR work from Home.
- **Back in the guide** first returns to the channel you are watching, then
  to the filters, then leaves.
- In the guide over the player, OK on a programme opens its options; OK on
  the channel still tunes to it.
- **Series recordings** are marked in the guide and the player: red when the
  showing will record, grey when the series rule skips it. Recording from
  the guide no longer reloads it.

## The player

- **Crop Black Bars**, under Video Playback Preferences, finds black bars
  baked into a video and crops them so the picture fills the screen, with
  subtitles kept on the picture. **Recrop Interval** sets how often it looks
  again. While it is on, the zoom button becomes Recrop. It is off until
  turned on. Zoom Mode's Auto Crop is now called Zoom to Fill and works as
  before.
- **Playback Information** is laid out in sections (Playback, Video, Audio,
  Subtitles, Display, File and Technical) and says what was converted from
  what, such as "SDR (converted from HDR10)". Emby transcodes now list why.

## TV keyboard

- **Keyboard Style**, under Settings > Personalization > General Style:
  Native (the TV's own keyboard), Classic, Glass or Docked. Everyone keeps
  the keyboard they had.
- The in-app keyboard has caret keys, a Paste key, AZERTY or QWERTZ in French
  and German-family languages, a number pad for number-only fields, and
  holding Backspace clears the field. Its keyboard key now offers the four
  styles.

## Libraries

- **Video Library Style**, under Settings > Personalization > Libraries:
  Classic as before, Modern with a bar along the top, or Docked with a panel
  down the side.

## Seerr

- A request's download bar says when it is Stalled, Failed, Paused or
  Queued, or "Downloaded, waiting for import", and the details page shows it
  on the TV too.
- Administrators see why a request's download is stuck, with **Get a
  different release** and **Pick a release** on the Seerr details page.
  Either one removes the stuck download, its files included.
- Discover's title rows use Modern cards when Home uses Modern rows.
- Seerr keeps its own poster size, so picking one there leaves the library
  grids alone.

## Home and the media bar

- **Separate ratings for Home**, in the Ratings part of Settings >
  Personalization > Home Screen, and **Separate ratings for the media bar**,
  in the same place under Media Bar, let each choose its own ratings instead
  of following Metadata & Ratings. Both are off until turned on, and start
  from the ratings you have now.
